settings.text: Veloura began with a simple frustration: a beautiful perfume, a full bottle, and no way of knowing whether it would still feel right in a month. So we started opening the bottles ourselves.

settings.heading: Only the original. Never a copy.
settings.text: Every decant is drawn from a full bottle purchased from an authorised retailer or directly from the house. We never buy grey-market stock, never dilute, never blend. Batch codes and receipts are kept on file, and we share them on request.

settings.title: Sourced
settings.text: Full bottles from authorised retailers and the houses themselves.

settings.title: Decanted
settings.text: Sterile pipettes, clean glass, one fragrance at a time.

settings.title: Sealed
settings.text: Glass atomisers, labelled by hand with house, name and batch.

settings.title: Sent
settings.text: Wrapped and shipped within one working day.

settings.heading: How we decant
settings.text: Small batches, by hand, in a clean and quiet room.

settings.heading: Glass, not plastic.
settings.text: Perfume reacts with cheap plastics. Our 10 ml atomisers are glass with a fine-mist pump, so the fragrance you receive is the fragrance the perfumer intended. Around a hundred sprays: enough to know it well.
Veloura is an independent decant service and is not affiliated with the brands it carries. All trademarks belong to their respective owners. We are simply devoted customers who share.
